pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.point: The Special MC meets November 5, 2026 from 2:15 to 5:00 p.m. EPT in Audubon, PA.
pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.quote: Special Members Committee Two Hundred Ninety-first Meeting PJM Conference and Training Center, Audubon, PA November 5, 2026

pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.point: PJM gives notice of consultation with the Members Committee and Transmission Owners on tariff changes tied to the show cause order.
pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.quote: PJM Notice of Consultation with the Members Committee pursuant to Tariff Section 9.2(b) and Transmission Owners pursuant to CTOA Section 7.5.1(ii)

pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.point: PJM staff will consult on a suite of section 205 filings addressing the Large Load Show Cause Order and related reforms.
pjm-20261105-special-mc-agenda.quote: PJM staff will consult with stakeholders on plans to submit a suite of section 205 filings to address Tariff revisions to address opportunities identified in the Large Load Show Cause Order and related reforms.

pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.point: The meeting runs 11:50 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EPT in Audubon, PA, with administration, a consent agenda and reports.
pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.quote: Members Committee Two Hundred Ninetieth Meeting PJM Conference and Training Center, Audubon, PA October 28, 2026

pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.point: A regulatory activities report from Chris Holt is scheduled among the PJM reports.
pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.quote: Chris Holt will review PJM’s regulatory activities report.

pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.point: A Board discussion with stakeholders covers short-term priorities for PJM and the stakeholder process.
pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.quote: Jason Barker will facilitate stakeholder feedback and dialog with the PJM Board regarding short term priorities for PJM and the stakeholder process.

pjm-20261028-mc-agenda.point: A Special Members Committee meeting follows on November 5, 2026 at 2:15 p.m.

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: PJM reports FERC dismissed rehearing and clarification requests on the show cause order as premature, with the proceeding in abeyance through November 16, 2026.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: FERC concluded that the Show Cause Order is not a final agency action, because it made only preliminary findings and initiated further proceedings

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: The report notes FERC will give no clarification while the abeyance lets PJM's stakeholder process and section 205 filings proceed.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: FERC also declined to provide clarification while this proceeding remains in abeyance through November 16, 2026

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: On October 9 FERC accepted part of PJM's Large Load definition and registry filing and set a November 8 compliance date for the rest.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: The Commission directed PJM to submit a compliance filing by November 8, 2026, of the tariff sections with the Large Load definition and the Large Load Registry

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: On September 29 FERC accepted the Reliability Backstop Procurement revisions effective February 28, 2027, and opened EL26-108 on cost allocation, exit responsibility and collateral.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: the Commission accepted PJM’s proposed Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) Tariff revisions, subject to refund and further proceedings and effective February 28, 2027.

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: PJM asked on October 12 to hold the EL26-108 paper hearing in abeyance pending its forthcoming section 205 filing.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: requesting to hold the paper hearing proceedings, and any additional briefings, in abeyance pending resolution of PJM’s forthcoming Section 205 filing

pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.point: DOE emergency orders under FPA section 202(c) let PJM direct backup generation at large loads to run before or during an EEA 3.
pjm-20261028-mc-regulatory-report.quote: authorizing PJM to direct backup generation resources at large loads to operate as a last resort before declaring an Energy Emergency Alert (“EEA”) 3 or during an EEA 3

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: The coalition says the show cause order calls for large load improvements but does not require an overhaul of the generation interconnection queue.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: While the Order calls for improvements to large load integration, it does not require PJM to overhaul its entire generation interconnection queue.

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: Under PJM's proposal a load approved just after the annual cutoff could wait nearly two years from transmission owner approval to completing the PJM process.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: that could mean nearly two years between Transmission Owner approval and completion of the PJM process.

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: Paired generation could be held out of the queue during that wait.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: If paired generation must enter the process with the load, the generator could be held out of the queue during that wait, delaying new supply that PJM urgently needs.

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: The letter says MISO and SPP run parallel but coordinated planning processes instead of one combined cluster.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: generally use parallel but coordinated planning processes before bringing them together into an integrated system plan

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: The coalition asks the Board to direct staff either to explain non-compliance with the 60 to 90 day application and study directive or to narrow the response.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: Explain why it is not directly complying with the Show Cause Order directives to establish an application and study process for the provision of transmission service for large loads that is 60–90 days or less

pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.point: The coalition supports piloting study automation inside the existing Cycle process.
pjm-20261005-ceba-dcc-letter-to-pjm-boar.quote: We also support PJM beginning to pilot and validate study automation, which can be done today within the Cycle process.
